places.name: freshpod sg - NCS Hub
places.address: 5 Ang Mo Kio Street 62, NCS Hub, Singapore 569141

reviews.author: wuuyeahh
reviews.text: lovely meal! I enjoyed the protein bowl very much and the portion is just nice for me :)))

reviews.author: Li Ping Lee
reviews.text:
Super fresh, wholesome and satisfying! Best part - the price point. It’s hard to find healthy bowls under $10 anywhere in Singapore now, and this one was only $8 with a substantial portion.
Love the ordering experience- it was fun and seamless

reviews.author: Alan Chong
reviews.text: The roast beef is tender, will order again!

reviews.author: Denise Chiew
reviews.text: Fresh and decent variety. Good option after workout or on quick lunch days. Love that there are seasonal flavours and menu refreshes every now and then.

reviews.author: vera poh
reviews.text: The salad serve fresh and the serving is good! Highly recommend :)

places.name: McDonald's
places.address: 18 Marina Gardens Dr, #02-04 Garden By The Bay, Singapore 018954

reviews.author: attahngrm
reviews.text:
My first time for coming here at night after watching supertree grove light & music show.

Seem crowded but when u order & paying by self system was easy & wait for the food wasn't too long. The place is safe & comfortable though it's not very large.

Dining option when you're confused about what u want to eat 🫠

reviews.author: S L
reviews.text: Gardens by the Bay outlet has indoor & outdoor seating. The indoor was full but I managed to find a seat. Ordered from the kiosk, paid at the counter, got my ice cream in under 3 mins. Thick and good!

reviews.author: Potato Head
reviews.text:
Visited on a Saturday afternoon, and surprisingly it was not overly crowded.

However, the overall operation did not feel very smooth. The sauce for the nuggets was forgotten, and the muffin I ordered was replaced with a different type of bun by mistake.

While none of the issues were major individually, the repeated small errors gave the impression that the outlet was struggling operationally.

The experience itself was still manageable, but there is definitely room for improvement in consistency and attention to detail.

reviews.author: Tay Tiow Boon
reviews.text:
Visited Gardens By The Bay yesterday.  Had lunch at McDonald. Ordered 2 sets of  2pcs Chicken + Large Sprite + Large Fries. Restaurant packed with Tourist & Locals.  About $12/set (/Pax)

Service Staff Mr. Nicholas was very friendly & helpful; going all out in providing great services. Highly commendable.

Chicken Sets delivered fast.  No wait.
Great lunch.  Many thanks to Nic.

reviews.author: Camy Cheng
reviews.text:
Waited more than 30mins for my mobile order.
Then when I tried to ask someone, lady in yellow said "one minute", lady in black just said "Yaya coming."

Turns out there's a duplicated order number. So they did my order quickly. Then when I went home, realized they got one of the burgers wrong. Ordered beef but came chicken.

places.name: BACINO Italian Bistro
places.address: 218 Pasir Panjang Rd, #01-03 ICON @ PASIR PANJANG, Singapore 118579

reviews.author: LB
reviews.text:
BACINO the Cozy Italian Gem in Pasir Panjang You Need to Try Immediately!

Tucked away in Pasir Panjang, BACINO is a warm, intimate Italian bistro that feels like a little slice of Italy right here in Singapore. Think delicious, authentic Italian cuisine paired with an impressive selection of wines — most of the ingredients and bottles are imported straight from Italy, which you can truly taste and appreciate in every dish and sip.

I first met the owner back in 2024 at a nice Italian wine event. When our paths crossed again recently, I knew I had to check the place out with a couple of my good friends. We had a feeling the food and wine would be excellent… and YES, were we right!

From the moment we walked in, we really like everything — the cosy ambience, the flavours on the plate, the drinks, the owner’s warm hospitality, and the attentive service team. It was so good that we ended up going back three times in one week. Sounds crazy? Maybe. But once you taste it for yourself, you’ll understand 🤭

BACINO also has some really good lunch and drinks deals, so there’s never a bad time to drop by.

Do yourself a favour and head over soon. You won’t be disappointed — in fact, you might just become a regular like us.

reviews.author: Kirby c
reviews.text:
The chef is serious about his food! So far the best Aglio olio i have ever had. Technique and execution of dish is chefs kiss, right amount of garlic, oil and heat. The emulsification is perfect which makes the sauce incredibly creamy.
Have tried some of the other pasta dishes, they were pretty good as well but the star is definitely aglio olio
Cherry on top is the tiramisu which was part of the lunch set, strong coffee w generous sprinkle of cocoa powder, which was a great end to the meal
Even though i dont really like just eating carbs for a meal, i would gladly come back for the aglio olio again.

reviews.author: Lis
reviews.text: Hands down to the best carbonara in Singapore that i’ve had. Better than many big names in the centre. Don’t be fool as the chef is super clear about his food: it’s must be delicious and authentic. We love the risotto as well. Its deep seafood flavour is subtly hinted with acidic balance. Definitely worth a trip.

reviews.author: Denise Ong
reviews.text: Tried the porchetta, cacio e pepe and osso buco. Dessert was tiramisu. Would recommend the porchetta as a starter and definitely highly recommend the osso buco. The team shared with us that the meat was slow cooked over 6 hours and mashed potatoes were homemade. The taste of osso buco lingered in our mouth even after we had finished it. Goes well with red wine.

reviews.author: Angie Glen (AC)
reviews.text:
This review came 10mths late, lol. I kept thinking about their carbonara whenever I had any unsatisfatory ones elsewhere.

Brought my wife for a low-key birthday celebration last Nov end. She loves Italian cuisine and wanted to try long before it moved here. Started with bruschetta, squid ink risotto was great, and I had an unforgetable legit carbonara that I would gladly travel for an hour just to taste again. Sadly we're too full to order more but squeezed some space for their fantastic cannoli to round up the wonderful meal.

Highly recommended to give it a try and we'll definitely drop by when we're in the area.

reviews.author: G Z
reviews.text: Our furkid's regular groomer moved to sunset way, so we had a good 2 hours to our meal. The restaurant was pleasant and not too crowded on a Saturday and the manager came by to chat with us periodically. We ordered the  salted egg crab, "green dragon veggie" (青龙菜) and crabmeat fried rice. The first two were fantastic, but the crabmeat fried rice was a tad disappointing with barely any crabmeat and a lot of salted egg and century egg. Service was great as well and you get 10% off as a member! Will definitely return again the next time we bring our dog for grooming.

reviews.author: Sik Siaw Yan
reviews.text: Truly enjoyed the food here at a reasonable price. Every dish was flavorful and nicely prepared. The portions were generous and definitely worth the price. The staff here friendly,attentive and make us feel very welcomed throughout the meal. A great dining experience would definately come back again👍

reviews.author: admen Lim
reviews.text:
Food is alright total spend $280+++

Service seem abit shortage of manpower

Order raise hand no one attend not once but few time ended up need to go collect myself

Order food cannot speak Chinese only Malays …. English also abit don’t understand…. Very surprise..

Food was ok nothing much to complaint .. price was acceptable but with the amount spend I think can get better service and better food .

The chicken is abit dry and hard the rest are ok

First time there … not sure will go again .

reviews.author: Rishika Roy
reviews.text: That one thing which is very important for us is dining with our Gelato, our toy poodle. This place is extremely good with excellent seafood option. The staff is great and friendly. We enjoyed the food and the ambience.

reviews.author: Kenneth Kan
reviews.text:
Every dish is impressive. We tried the golden sauce (pumpkin) sri lankan crab, salted egg eggplants and cereal prawns.  The restaurant is honest and lets you choose the seafood with transparent prices and gave good advice. The staff is extremely friendly and a lot of people come to the restaurant for birthday celebrations.

You cannot miss the dessert. Both durian and coconut pudding are so fragrant, smooth and creamy. It is better to make reservations or even call the restaurant to reserve the crabs.

places.name: Super Thai by Soi Aroy @ Pasir Panjang

reviews.author: alky
reviews.text: Really like the atmosphere of this place. The service was very good and the food was tasty as well! Really like the som tam, it was flavourful and tasty with the right amount of spice. Olive fried rice was solid as well! The drunken noodles had a good amount of wok hei but I wished the flavour was a little stronger. But overall, a pretty satisfying meal!!

reviews.author: Aiwen Huang
reviews.text: Really enjoyed the set meal! Great value for money, with generous portions and a nice variety of dishes. Everything was delicious and freshly prepared. The service was friendly and the overall dining experience was excellent. Definitely worth trying, and I’ll be coming back again!

reviews.author: Teck Chong Law
reviews.text:
The set lunch is indeed value for money.  One main + two sides + one drink for $12.90 👍

The taste of the food was just average.

The aircon was not strong enough, so the restaurant was quite warm, and the aircon was making this weird sound throughout our meal.

reviews.author: Eugene Leong
reviews.text:
The portions for the set are quite large, and could feed more than specified.

Loved the deep fried kang kong. It came w a sauce that helped to neutralise the greasiness.

The pork meat of the green curry was soft and chewy.

Ended off with the coconut ice cream which was extremely refreshing to end with!

The dining area was spacious for dinner between 7-8pm. All in all a great meal!

reviews.author: Tim Chen
reviews.text: Hands down some of the most delicious Thai food in the area! The flavors are vibrant and authentic, and having beer and wine on the menu makes it the perfect dinner spot. A special shoutout to Nana and Ella—they are exceptionally friendly, fun, and make you feel right at home from the moment you walk in. Can’t wait to come back!
